metadata.description: Procedural writing-style skills for AI agents — official frameworks, not vibes.

plugins.name: writing-skills
plugins.description: 14 writing-style skills: 7 measurable frameworks (plain language, BLUF business writing, corporate comms, GOV.UK, ASD-STE100, Google dev docs, AP journalism) and 7 character voices (Ted Lasso, Jack Sparrow, Shrek, Yoda, Winnie the Pooh, Paddington, Bob Ross). Each framework enforces a verifiable checklist.
